sections.section_title: OTG device OUT endpoint x DMA address register (OTG_DOEPDMAx)
sections.text_helper: Section 73.14.57 "OTG device OUT endpoint x DMA address register (OTG_DOEPDMAx)" in chapter 73 (USB on-the-go high-speed (OTG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3855.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0xB14 + 0x20 * x, (x = 0 to 8)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 DMAADDR[31:0]: DMA Address
This field holds the start address in the external memory from which the data for the
endpoint must be fetched. This register is incremented on every AHB transaction.
